svg.title: The living shade pocket
svg.desc: A west-side vine screen climbs a small trellis; a soil trough separates planting from the clear route.. Bus stop concept with perspective and accessible site plan.
svg.text: A west-side vine screen climbs a small trellis; a soil trough separates planting from the clear route.
KEEP CLEAR · continuous 1.8 m walking route
Cooler, softer seasonal shade, but slow establishment and watering / pruning make this the highest-upkeep option.
